budget_items.topic: LAT Videographer roles moved from contractors to employees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The LAT Senior Videographer and Videographer roles were included in the current budget, and some current workers were paid on 1099s before becoming employees.
budget_items.quote: videographer, both were included in the current budget. these roles created as current interpretation of how town utilizes contractors has changed.

budget_items.topic: State minimum wage and SAP step grid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Several lower grade roles in the step grid have step one below the Massachusetts State Minimum Wage, and alternatives are being reviewed.
budget_items.quote: currently the step grid has several lower grade roles where step one is less than minimum wage.

budget_items.topic: Seasonal DPW roles moved to town payroll
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Seasonal DPW laborer/truck driver and similar intermittent roles now need to be employees on the town payroll rather than contractors or vendors, a change for snow removal contractors.
budget_items.quote: this role and any others that fall into similar roles as intermittent workers now need to be considered employees and on the town payroll.
